  - Backend: Node.js with Express
  - Database: MongoDB
  - Features: Authentication, real-time visualization, data processing

- [x] Scaffold the Project
  - Created frontend and backend directories
  - Set up basic project structure

  - Created backend with Node.js

    - Created controllers for handling data processing

  - Configured authentication system with JWT and OTP

  - No specific extensions required

  - Configured proper build and development scripts

  - Created development tasks for frontend and backend
  - Added a combined task to run both simultaneously

  - Set up launch configurations in tasks.json
